decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposal would result in the loss of the employment use of this site contrary to Policy E.1.1a of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan (1996) and Policy E.1.5 of the Revised Unitary Development Plan (2001).
Condition : 2 - The proposal does not provide any affordable housing contrary to Policies H.2.1 and H.3.5 of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan (2001).

Condition : 3 - The proposal would result in damage to and the potential loss of trees subject to a Tree Preservation Order. This is contrary to Policies ENV-N.2.7 and ENV-N.2.8 of the Proposed Unitary Development Plan (2001) and Policies ENV.1.9 and ENV.1.10 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan (1996).

Condition : 4 - The proposed residential development would have a significantly detrimental impact on privacy and light and would be overbearing to adjoining neighbours contrary to Policies ENV.1.1 and H.1.2 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan (1996) and Policies ENV-B.1.1, H.3.5 and H.4.1 of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan (2001) and Supplementary Planning Guidance (1997).

Condition : 5 - The proposal would not relate well to the adjoining Conservation Area and would thereby be detrimental to its setting. This would be contrary to Policies ENV.1.1, and ENV.1.2 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan (1996) and Policies ENV-B.1.1, and ENV-B.2.2 of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan (2001).

Condition : 6 - The layout, excessive density and inadequate amenity space would result in an overdevelopment of the site contrary to Policies ENV.1.1, ENV.1.2 , H.1.2 and H.1.4 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan and Policies ENV-B.1.1, ENV-B.2.2, H.3.5, H.4.1 and H.4.2 of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan (2001) and Supplementary Planning Guidance (1997).
description: Demolition of existing workshop/stores and the erection of 9  Dwelling Houses with associated landscaping and parking.
